title: Audit closed WIII remediation and clean obsolete worktrees

sources.reason: Defines the completed WIII V2 task sequence and conditional truth-alignment rule.
Records the prior independent integration/truth conclusion and its limits.
Provides the final closed predecessor outcome.
Defines Work Item closure, branch, and cleanup lifecycle rules.

rawUserRequest: 整个计划完成以后，增加自检，发现问题以后，修复，再自检，有问题再修复。。。循环到全部闭环。最后，发布新版本。完成全部工单包括PR和清理。明确授权给你，并写入Contract。如果没有问题，请开始。全部完成为止不要停止。

declaredIntent.summary: Independently audit closed WIII remediation evidence, repair any evidenced gap through separate Work Items, and remove obsolete local branch/worktree identities before release.

problemStatement: All planned WIII remediation Work Items are merged, but final completion is unproven until their archival/PR/closure evidence, interfaces, generated truth documents, and obsolete local worktree identities are independently checked against current origin/main.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Every required WIII remediation and parallelism Work Item has an archived Contract/Summary/Outcome, merged PR, and lifecycle closure evidence on current origin/main.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The audit lists the exact evidence inspected and reports no missing lifecycle link.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect archive manifests, GitHub PR state, current branch ancestry, and closure receipts where retained.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The current WIII interface and capability statements retain repository-local read-only, Agent-scheduled, no-retry/no-cancel boundaries.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Focused interface, integration, and generated-document checks agree with current main behavior.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run focused WIII tests and the declared documentation/capability generators and checks.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Obsolete non-merged predecessor worktree and local branches are removed only after exact target, absent remote PR/branch, and retained merged replacement evidence are verified.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The audit records the target identities and confirms only obsolete local identities were removed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use git worktree/branch/remote read-only inspection before and after recoverable worktree/branch cleanup.

riskAssessment.reason: Audit conclusions must be evidence-based and cleanup must not delete a branch or worktree with retained lifecycle value; no product runtime behavior is changed.

reasons: The Work Item changes governance documentation and generated evidence and performs bounded local cleanup after proof.

executionDecision.reason: The owner explicitly authorized the closure audit, repair loop, cleanup, and subsequent release; all audit evidence is repository/GitHub readable.

preReviewWarnings: Verify every conclusion against current evidence, do not modify frozen archives, preserve the WIII/Agent boundary, and prove exact cleanup targets before deletion.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A canonical audit document enumerates every completed WIII/parallelism deliverable and the exact current evidence for its merged/closed state.
The audit independently verifies current WIII interface boundaries and generated truth/document alignment; any concrete finding becomes a separate corrective Work Item before release.
Only proven obsolete local predecessor worktrees/branches are removed; current main, merged evidence, tags, remote branches, and immutable archives are preserved.
Focused checks, declared generators, all required governance checks, ai-finish, PR, merge, and ai-close-work-item pass.
guidelines: Audit findings must cite current repository or provider evidence; do not infer completion from intent or old claims.
Keep WIII repository-local and read-only; Agent/subagent scheduling remains outside WIII.
Delete only an exact verified obsolete local worktree or branch; never alter archived records, tags, current main, or a remote branch without the dedicated lifecycle command.

intent.problem: The plan requires a self-audit and repair loop after all functional Work Items; completion and release cannot be claimed until current evidence proves the full lifecycle and cleanup state.
constraints: One Task remains one Work Item, branch, worktree, and PR; this audit does not schedule Agents or alter WIII behavior.
Do not rewrite immutable archives or delete/move release tags, main, or remote branches outside ai-close-work-item.
If the audit finds a product/documentation defect, stop its delivery and create a separate corrective Work Item rather than expanding this audit scope.
Local cleanup is limited to exact obsolete predecessor worktree/branch identities after read-only proof.
intent.rationale: A separate current-state audit converts the requested iterative self-check into durable evidence and prevents stale experimental worktree identities from being mistaken for active work.

allowPatterns: exact pre-inventoried obsolete local WIII predecessor branch and worktree identities

approvalEvidence.reason: The repository owner explicitly authorized all Work Items, PRs, cleanup, audit repair loops, and release. Cleanup is limited to exact identities inventoried before deletion.

scope: exact pre-inventoried obsolete local WIII predecessor branch and worktree identities

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: No restricted repository path is changed by this audit; local worktree cleanup is authorized separately through destructiveChangePolicy.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
